mapper.insert: INSERT INTO purchase_order (order_uid, request_id, campaign_id, user_id, status, created_at, expire_at) VALUES (#{orderUid}, #{requestId}, #{campaignId}, #{userId}, 'PENDING', NOW(6), NOW(6) + INTERVAL 15 MINUTE)
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM purchase_order WHERE campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND active_flag = 1 ) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM purchase_order WHERE request_id = #{requestId}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM purchase_order WHERE order_uid = #{orderUid})
